blocks.content: Explore a pie chart to see how it answers "How much of the total does each part make up?" and what that total includes.
Open the **Popular JS Frameworks** pie chart.
Find **Vue** and **React.js** in the legend. Compare the sizes of their slices.

The larger slice represents a larger share of the included star counts. All six libraries' slices add to 100%. The whole is their combined count, not all libraries, all developers, or all library usage.

The bar chart answers "Which count is larger?" The pie answers "What share of this included total does each count represent?" Use a pie only when adding the numeric values produces a meaningful whole.
You've read a share and defined its denominator. Next, inspect the row-level detail that summary charts leave out.
